Cody Williams and John Konchar combine to make nearly $3M less than Green, and save another $1.3M because they're two people rather than one and thus soak up Wolves' 14th roster spot.

items.title: I like that deal for Minnesota. They take a flyer on Williams, maybe Konchar gives them a little something and they create the room to sign Kuminga. Pretty good deal.

items.title: Final: Sparks 88, Mystics 82. Rae Burrell scored 12 of her 15 in the fourth, and Los Angeles gets a good win over Washington with a fantastic second-half showing, allowing only 31 points. Nneka Ogwumike scored 24. They forced 17 Washington turnovers. Sparks are 14-25.
